title: Junior Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Gestalte die digitale Welt von morgen als Junior Product Manager. Natürlich mit AI.


Digitale Produkte, Apps und Webprojekte sind die Welt, in der du arbeiten möchtest?


Dich faszinieren Technologie, Business Context und das Nutzererlebnis, und du möchtest digitale Produkte mitgestalten, ohne selbst in die tiefen von Codeschichten einzutauchen?


Dann ist die Rolle eines Product Managers genau das Richtige für dich!


Wir, die Digitale Leute School, bilden Product und Tech-Rollen in unseren Bootcamps aus und unterstützen dich beim Einstieg in deine erste oder nächste Tech-Position. (Weiterbildung)


Unser nächster Kurs startet bald und wir haben noch Plätze frei!


Starte als Quereinsteiger:in, Umsteiger:in, Junior oder Associate Product Manager in die Weiterbildung ein und finde dann deine erste Stelle.


Aufgaben


Die Inhalte:


Product Strategy & Discovery


Eine klare Produktstrategie hilft dir als Product Manager, das übergeordnete Ziel des Softwareprodukts zu definieren. Sie legt fest, welche Probleme dein Produkt löst, welche Bedürfnisse es erfüllt und welche Ziele es erreicht. Zudem bietet sie deinem gesamten Team eine gemeinsame Leitlinie und ermöglicht allen Beteiligten, auf dasselbe Ziel hinzuarbeiten.


    
    
 1. Product Vision & Strategy
    
    
 2. User Centricity
    
    
 3. User Research & Interviews
    
    
 4. Ideation & Problem-Solution Fit
    
    
 5. Business Models & Product-Market Fit
    
    
 6. Lean Product Management
    
    
 7. Product Goals mit OKRs
    
    


Product & UX Design


Im Product Management sind nutzerzentriertes Design und eine gute User Experience entscheidend für den Erfolg. Du erlernst die Grundlagen von Usability, User Experience und User-Interface-Design für Product Manager. Außerdem lernst du die notwendigen Tools für eine effektive Kommunikation mit Designern.


    
    
 1. Einführung ins UX/UI-Design & Tools
    
    
 2. Informationsarchitektur & Wireframes
    
    
 3. High-Fidelity-Prototyping
    
    
 4. User-Tests & Validierungsmethoden
    
    


Product Delivery & Stakeholder Management


Als Product Manager steuerst du dein Team durch agile Prozesse wie Scrum oder Kanban, um eine erfolgreiche Produktentwicklung sicherzustellen. Du lernst, wie die zentralen Meetings – Daily, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review und Sprint-Retrospektive – funktionieren und welche Erwartungen an dich hinsichtlich der Delivery gestellt werden. Zudem erhältst du wertvolle Einblicke in das Stakeholder-Management, um die Zusammenarbeit mit allen Beteiligten zu optimieren.


    
    
 1. Agile Methoden
    
    
 2. Elemente des Backlogs
    
    
 3. Rituale & Regeltermine (I)
    
    
 4. User Stories erstellen
    
    
 5. Technischer Hintergrund
    
    
 6. Rituale & Regeltermine II
    
    
 7. Roadmapping & Planning
    
    
 8. Workflows & Releases
    
    


Product Analytics & Testing


Als Product Manager misst du Wirkung statt Bauchgefühl: Du definierst klare KPIs, setzt sauberes Event-Tracking auf und liest Daten entlang von Funnel, Kohorten und Retention. So triffst du belastbare Entscheidungen, erkennst Risiken früh und bewertest Experimente sauber.


    
    
 1. Application Monitoring: Tool-Deep-Dive
    
    
 2. Manuelles (hands-on) Software-Testing
    
    
 3. KPIs & Tracking-Events
    
    
 4. Bug Reporting
    
    
 5. Web-Analytics mit Google Analytics und Looker Studio
    
    


Career-Coaching


Unser Karriere-Coaching richtet sich an angehende Product Manager. Wir schärfen dein Profil, machen Projekte und Ergebnisse sichtbar und entwickeln eine praxisnahe Such- und Bewerbungsstrategie. So greifen Unterlagen und dein LinkedIn-Auftritt ineinander – und du gehst souverän durch Interviews und Cases.


    
    
 1. Jobrecherche mit Keywords & Rollen
    
    
 2. Analyse der eigenen Stärken & Schwächen
    
    
 3. Lebenslauf und Bewerbungsunterlagen vorbereiten
    
    
 4. Tipps zum Bewerbungsprozess
    
    


Qualifikation

   
   
 * Du bist ein Fan von Technologie und kannst Dich für digitale Produkte begeistern
   
   
 * Du bist ehrgeizig und feierst gerne mit Deinem Team Euren gemeinsamen Erfolg
   
   
 * Du hast Spaß an agilen Arbeitsweisen (Scrum, Kanban, Pairing etc.)
   
   
 * Du kannst mit Deinen Visionen Kunden und Stakeholder von Deinen Plänen überzeugen
   
   
 * Du arbeitest gern im Team, zeigst Eigeninitiative und bist pragmatisch
   
   
 * Du hast Freude unternehmerisch zu denken
   
   
 * Du bist mutig — Ungewisse Situationen nimmst Du gerne als Herausforderung an
   
   


Benefits

   
   
 * Wir bilden dich innerhalb von 3 Monaten remote/online zum Product Manager aus (deutschsprachi, mind. B2)
   
   
 * Wir unterstützen dich, schon während der Weiterbildung ein Unternehmen zu finden, das dir einen Jobeinstieg während oder nach dem Bootcamp bietet
   
   
 * Die Ausbildung ist berufsbegleitend möglich
   
   
 * Du bekommst einen Mentor, der Dich durch das Programm führt und wirst die Arbeit in Product Teams simulieren
   
   
 * Nach drei Monaten kannst Du als Product Manager mit Zertifikat in digitale Produktteams einsteigen und weißt, was die Aufgaben eines strategisch Produktverantwortlichen sind
   
   


Du erhältst ein Zertifikat, alle Kursmaterial & ein breites Netzwerk. Wir empfehlen für den Kurs ein Sprachniveau von B2 in der deutschen Sprache.


Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und deine Bewerbung.

title: Junior Product Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Junior Product Analyst to help us research and synthesize complex organizational data. This role exists to support our advisors in drafting the clear, factual records that our clients rely on for their most important decisions.

About JHC Consulting
JHC Consulting is a private advisory practice that provides counsel to chief executives, chairs, and board committees. We help our clients navigate high stakes situations such as governance transitions and structural reorganizations. Our firm is built on the belief that a well reasoned seven page document is more valuable than a forty page slide deck. We do not facilitate consensus sessions or deliver polished presentations. Instead, we produce detailed memoranda that are authored, signed, and owned by a single individual. This approach ensures that our counsel provides a stable and intellectually honest foundation for the future of the organizations we serve. Our work is precise and demanding. We favor clarity over volume and evidence over assumption. Every engagement is grounded in the discipline of absolute discretion.

In this role
 * You will conduct deep research into organizational structures and historical corporate data.
 * You will fact check every claim made in a draft memorandum to ensure absolute accuracy before it reaches a client.
 * You will synthesize raw data from various sources into clear, secondary summaries for our lead advisors.
 * You will help maintain our internal archives of past decisions and organizational outcomes.
 * You will identify patterns in historical data that might influence a client's current strategic shift.
 * You will refine drafted text to remove unnecessary language and ensure every sentence serves a specific purpose.
 * You will monitor industry shifts and regulatory changes that impact the specific boards we advise.
   
   

What we are looking for
We need someone who values the written word as a tool for thinking. You should be the kind of person who enjoys reading a long report to find a single logical inconsistency or a missing piece of evidence. This role requires a high degree of patience and the ability to focus on complex documents for several hours at a time. Clarity of thought is more important to us than your ability to use specific data software. We expect you to be honest about what the research shows, even when the conclusion contradicts an initial assumption. You should have a natural curiosity about how large organizations function and how power is distributed within a boardroom. Accuracy is our primary metric for success. If you take pride in the precision of your work and prefer quiet analysis to group brainstorms, you will likely find this environment a good fit for your skills. We value candidates who can take a messy set of facts and organize them into a coherent narrative without losing sight of the underlying data.
While we do not require specific professional experience, a background in a discipline that requires rigorous writing can be helpful. This might include studies in history, law, or philosophy. We are interested in your ability to read critically and write clearly. No prior corporate experience is necessary. We will provide the training needed to understand our specific methodology for drafting memoranda. You must be comfortable working in a fully remote environment. This requires self discipline and a proactive approach to asking clarifying questions when a task is ambiguous. We value those who are comfortable working independently and who do not require constant supervision to maintain high standards.

Working at JHC Consulting
Working here means choosing deep work over constant communication. We protect your time so you can focus on the research at hand. Our culture is quiet and disciplined. We rely on clear written updates rather than frequent video calls or instant messaging. This is a fully remote position that allows you to manage your own schedule within the requirements of our project timelines. We offer direct mentorship that focuses on logic and the craft of professional writing. You will have the opportunity to see how the most significant corporate decisions are structured and recorded. We prioritize a sustainable pace of work that allows for high precision and long term career growth. Our firm is small and our relationships are built on mutual respect and intellectual integrity. You will be given the space to learn and the support to develop your analytical voice.
Our work provides a stable foundation for the future of the organizations we serve. We remain committed to the written record as the best tool for thoughtful leadership. This role is an opportunity to learn the craft of professional advisory in a firm that values analytical honesty above all else.

title: Founding Product Designer

What You'll Do

 * Collaborate directly with customers to understand their needs and translate them into elegant, usable solutions.
 * Identify new AI product opportunities, design concepts, and build prototypes in partnership with customers.
 * Create intuitive interfaces suited to AI-first workflows where conventional UI paradigms may not fit.
 * Work side-by-side with engineers to ship features at pace without sacrificing quality.
   
   

What We're Looking For

Must-haves


 * 3+ years of experience on product design teams.
 * Proficiency with modern prototyping and design tools including Figma, Lovable, V0, and Figma Make.
 * Meaningful touchpoints with AI/LLMs and genuine enthusiasm for building software in an AI-native way.
 * Collaborative working style with software engineers; comfortable understanding technical trade-offs and accepting pragmatic implementations.

Nice To Have

Location

This role is based on-site in Berlin, Germany. Candidates should be willing and able to work in-person in Berlin. Visa sponsorship is available.

A Y Combinator-backed, pre-seed AI voice automation SaaS startup building intelligent voice agents that help B2C businesses automate sales, customer service, and operations at scale. The platform supports capabilities such as lead qualification, appointment scheduling, payment collection, multilingual deployments, CRM integrations, and real-time analytics — serving customers across Europe and North America.

title: Product Manager (Services)
description:
Company

Founded in Berlin, autarc is a ~40 person start-up who were part of Y Combinator’s S24 batch in San Francisco. Our team consists of people in Sales, Tech and Operations, with the Engineering & Product department currently ~20 people, as we continue to grow throughout the year.

Role Description

You'll own Product for our fastest-growing product area: Services. On top of their monthly subscription, our customers can book additional services through autarc — such as government subsidy applications (e.g. KfW), energy performance certificates, and more. This area is scaling rapidly and we're hiring a dedicated PM to match.

Your job is to figure out what services we should build next, ship them fast with engineering, and roll them out across Europe. That means new service types, new country rollouts (Italy, UK, France), and new workflows — often from zero to live in days, not weeks. We expect you to go all-in on AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Cursor) to prototype, spec, and even ship parts of features yourself.

Other things you'll do will include:


 * Own the Services roadmap end-to-end and prioritise ruthlessly with the founders
 * Talk to installers weekly to understand subsidy, certification and admin pain points first-hand
 * Map local regulations and partner requirements when launching services in new European markets
 * Write crisp Linear tickets and PRDs that engineering can ship from on day one
 * Partner closely with Design and Engineering to deliver features at speed
 * Use AI tools to prototype workflows (document generation, form pre-filling, validation) before handing off to engineering
 * Own commercial outcomes for Services: attach rate, revenue per customer, fulfilment margin
   
   

This role sits between Product, Operations and Commercial — you'll be measured on shipped impact, not tickets written.

Requirements


 * 3+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, or ops-heavy products
 * Track record of shipping fast in a 0→1 environment — you've launched new product areas, not just iterated on mature ones
 * Strong written communication — you can write a PRD, a customer-facing changelog, and a Linear ticket with equal clarity
 * Comfortable with ambiguity, regulation, and operational complexity (subsidies, certifications, government workflows don't scare you)
 * Already using AI tools (Claude, Cursor) in your daily workflow, not just experimenting
 * Commercial instinct — you think in attach rates, margins, and payback, not just NPS
 * Berlin-based, hybrid 3 days in the office (Mitte)
 * Fluent in English (German is a strong plus given customer and regulatory context)
   
   

Nice to haves:


 * Experience in climate tech, energy, fintech, or another regulated B2B space
 * Exposure to European market rollouts and localisation
 * You've written code or shipped prototypes yourself
   
   

What We Offer


 * Freedom to choose your own equipment (within a budget)
 * 26 paid vacation days
 * An annual team retreat
 * The choice between Dance or JobRad for mobility
 * The choice between Classpass or Urban Sports Club for fitness
 * Regular team events, lunches and activities
   
   

Next steps


 * Screening call with Louis (Recruiter)
 * Deep-dive conversation with Etienne (CEO)
 * Practical case study
 * Final on-site with the team
   
   

About Us

Right now, 25% of CO2 emissions in Europe are caused by heating our buildings. In order for this to be reduced, the transition towards renewable energy needs to be simplified and made more accessible. There are too few installers to meet the growing demand for heat pumps, and a solution to match this trend needs to be brought to the market.

autarc is developing the leading operating system (OS) for heat pump installers, enabling a more digital and efficient installation process for heat pumps.

Through this, autarc is reducing the hurdles to decarbonizing single-family homes and small apartment buildings in Europe, with the goal to help with the planning and designing of 1 million heat pumps by 2030.

title: Merchandising Coordinator (m/f/d)
description:
Job description:



Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

 

JOB PURPOSE

We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Retail Merchandising Coordinator (m/f/d) to join our dynamic PRADA team at our head office in Munich. This role is temporary due to maternity cover. With this exciting opportunity you can gain hands-on experience in the world of luxury fashion. As a key support for our Retail Merchandising Team, you will contribute to the management of product assortments, market analysis, and collaboration with various teams to optimize performance.

At PRADA, we are committed to luxury, style, and innovation. As a global leader in the fashion industry, we pride ourselves on creating exceptional experiences for our clientele. Our Retail Merchandising Team plays a crucial role in ensuring our stores are perfectly aligned with customer preferences and brand vision.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Support the Retail Merchandising Team in managing some product categories for the Central Europe region
 * Preparing reports, statistics, and analyses on market trends and competitors
 * Provide support for store inquiries and maintain regular communication with store staff
 * Close collaboration with Visual Merchandising to implement purchasing strategies in-store displays
 * Creation of presentations and evaluations for internal and external stakeholders
 * Assist with organizing and conducting product training sessions
 * Preparation of reports, statistics, and analyses on trends and competitors

 

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Previous experience in a similar role as Trainee or Intern in (luxury) Retail environment

Completed a degree in Business Administration, Fashion Management, or a related field

A strong interest in luxury fashion and an understanding of industry trends

Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint); SAP knowledge is a plus

title: Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d)
description:
Gestalte die digitale Welt von morgen als UX/UI Designer!


Digitale Produkte, Apps und Webprojekte sind die Welt, in der du arbeiten möchtest?


Dich faszinieren Technologie, Design und das Nutzererlebnis, und du möchtest digitale Produkte mitgestalten, ohne selbst in die tiefen von Codeschichten einzutauchen?


Dann ist die Rolle eines Product Designers UX/UI genau das Richtige für dich!


Wir, die Digitale Leute School, bilden Product Designer (UX/UI) in unseren Bootcamps aus und vermitteln sie in Einsteigerpositionen. (Weiterbildung)


Unser nächster Kurs startet bald und wir haben noch Plätze frei!


Starte als Quereinsteiger:in, Umsteiger:in, Junior:in oder Associate Designer (UX/UI) in die Product Designer Weiterbildung und finde dann deine erste Stelle.


Aufgaben


Die Inhalte


Steuerung von Designprozessen


Als UX/UI Designer arbeitest du eng mit einem Team von Entwickler:innen, Stakeholder:innen und anderen Beteiligten zusammen, um nutzerzentrierte Lösungen zu schaffen. Du nimmst an regelmäßigen Teammeetings teil, bei denen ihr euch über Fortschritte austauscht und sicherstellt, dass das Design den Erwartungen entspricht.


User Research & Nutzer


Du führst qualitative und quantitative Forschungen durch, um die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen zu verstehen. Dabei nutzt du Methoden wie Interviews, Umfragen und Datenanalysen, um Personas und Customer Journeys zu erstellen, die den Designprozess leiten.


Prototyping & Wireframing


Du entwickelst Ideen und visualisierst sie in Form von Wireframes und interaktiven Prototypen, um diese mit Nutzer:innen zu testen und zu optimieren. Deine Konzepte helfen Teams und Stakeholdern, Designideen klar zu verstehen und weiterzuentwickeln.


Usability-Tests & Design-Optimierung


Du planst und führst Usability-Tests durch, um sicherzustellen, dass deine Designs intuitiv und benutzerfreundlich sind. Durch die Auswertung von Testergebnissen sammelst du Feedback, das direkt in die Optimierung der Benutzeroberfläche einfließt.


Produkt- & User Experience Design


Du gestaltest das Erlebnis und die Benutzeroberfläche des Produkts, damit es sowohl gut aussieht als auch einfach zu bedienen ist. Du erstellst Prototypen und Designs, die zeigen, wie das Produkt und aussehen soll und funktioniert.


Tracking & Analyse


Du beobachtest, wie Nutzer:innen mit dem Produkt umgehen, um herauszufinden, ob das Design funktioniert. Mit diesen Informationen kannst du das Design weiter verbessern und sicherstellen, dass es den Bedürfnissen der Nutzer entspricht.


Qualifikation

   
   
 * Du bist begeistert von Design und Technologie und liebst es, digitale Erlebnisse zu gestalten
   
   
 * Du arbeitest gern im Team und freust dich, gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern
   
   
 * Du hast Spaß an agilen Arbeitsmethoden (z. B. Scrum, Kanban) und iterierst Designs schnell
   
   
 * Du kannst deine Designideen klar kommunizieren und Stakeholder von deinem Konzept überzeugen
   
   
 * Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, bringst kreative Lösungen ein und arbeitest pragmatisch
   
   
 * Du hast ein starkes Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Unterschied machen
   
   
 * Du gehst mit Mut und Neugier an Herausforderungen heran und findest innovative Ansätze für komplexe Probleme
   
   


Benefits

   
   
 * Wir bilden dich innerhalb von 4 Monaten remote/online zum UX/UI Designer aus (deutschsprachig)
   
   
 * Wir unterstützen dich, schon während der Weiterbildung ein Unternehmen zu finden, das dir einen Jobeinstieg während oder nach dem Bootcamp bietet
   
   
 * Die Ausbildung ist berufsbegleitend möglich
   
   
 * Du bekommst einen Mentor, der Dich durch das Programm führt und wirst die Arbeit in Product Teams simulieren
   
   
 * Nach vier Monaten kannst Du als Product Designer / UX/UI Designer mit Zertifikat in digitale Produktteams einsteigen und weißt, was die Aufgaben eines Product Designers sind
   
   


Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und deine Bewerbung.

title: (Senior) Product Manager | Carbmee
description:
Intro

We're building the infrastructure for corporate carbon management, and we're looking for a (Senior) Product Manager to help shape it. You'll own product modules end-to-end, work directly with enterprise customers, and operate at the intersection of complex technical problems and real business impact. This is a role for someone who moves fast, makes decisions with incomplete information, and genuinely enjoys the messiness of building in a scale-up.

Your tasks


 * Own the full lifecycle of your product modules: from discovery through delivery and iteration
 * Work closely with engineering, design, and commercial teams to ship products enterprise customers actually use
 * Engage directly with customers to understand their needs and translate them into sharp product decisions
 * Drive sales enablement and support go-to-market for your modules where needed
 * Use AI tools and modern workflows to move faster and build smarter
 * Travel to customers 1-2 times per quarter
   
   

Your profile


 * Proven product management experience in a B2B software environment: ideally a scale-up with enterprise customers
 * Technical background (Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent): you can hold your own in architecture discussions and dig into the details
 * AI-savvy: you use AI tools in your day-to-day work and understand where they create leverage
 * Self-directed and decisive: you don't wait for strategy to be handed to you
 * Strong communicator and stakeholder manager, comfortable with both customers and internal teams
 * High ownership and drive: you care about outcomes, not just output
   
   

Nice to have: experience with data (SQL, dashboards, integrations), UI/UX sensibility, or product marketing / sales support exposure.

You'll thrive here if you're energized by ambiguity, move fast, and want real ownership over what you build: not just a seat at the table.

Benefits

Benefits


 * Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
 * Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options
 * Health & Wellbeing: Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
 * Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: a flexible hybrid working culture with a lovely accessible office in Berlin-Mitte or the center of Munich
 * Team Culture: Our transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
 * Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
 * Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals
   
   

About Carbmee

carbmee is on a mission to help the world's most emissions-intensive industries (automotive, manufacturing, logistics, chemicals) get carbon reduction under management. Our patented Environmental Intelligence System, carbmee EIS™, gives enterprises like Maersk, Miele, and Coca-Cola the precision carbon data they need to reduce cost, risk, and carbon at scale.

Founded in Berlin in 2021, we closed a €20M Series A in December 2024 and are growing fast. This is the moment to join.

About Us

carbmee is an Enterprise Software company built for the architectural backbone of the global economy. In an era where sustainability defines a company’s right to operate, we provide the System of Action for the world’s most complex manufacturing sectors with a strong footprint in Automotive and Defense.

We specialize in high-stakes, large-scale enterprise deployments where environmental data is no longer just a reporting requirement, but a critical strategic asset. Our platform empowers global industry leaders to transform fragmented data points into actionable intelligence, enabling them to make the defining decisions for the future of their products and supply chains.

At the heart of carbmee is a team of world-class talent: a powerhouse of engineers, industry experts, and visionaries dedicated to solving the most pressing industrial challenges of our time. We believe that solving the "hard-to-abate" problem requires the best minds in the world, and we are constantly looking for exceptional individuals to join our mission. We are calling this the "Industry Endgame".

Backed by a €20M Series A from top-tier investors and operating out of our hubs in Berlin and Munich, we are scaling rapidly, having the ambition to build a generational software company out of Germany.

title: Data Analyst
description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

We are seeking a Data Analyst with a passion for uncovering insights that drive growth. This pivotal role is for a highly analytical individual who will directly influence our product, rewards, marketing, and user acquisition strategies through deep dives into user behaviour and advanced predictive modelling.

Join us and become a central force in optimising our user acquisition and incentivisation, for maximising Lifetime Value (LTV) for millions of users.

What You'll Do 🎯


 * Focus on Causal Analysis: Quantify the causal impact of monetary incentives and product features on user retention. Identify the key behavioural drivers that lead to long-term LTV growth across Freecash and Link.
 * Design, Run and Analyse A/B tests: Own the end-to-end experimentation lifecycle (design, power analysis, execution, and interpretation). Use A/B and multivariate testing to validate causal hypotheses and drive measurable incremental growth, across different domains (product, rewards, UA) to drive incremental outcomes for business top line and bottom line.
 * Drive Predictive Analytics: Focus on analysing user behaviour and marketing activities to predict key metrics like Return on Ad Spend, identifying high-value user segments and opportunities for growth.
 * Deep User Segmentation: Lead in developing and applying advanced user segmentation models, providing actionable insights that inform product development, marketing strategies, and personalised user experiences.
 * Performance Optimisation & Strategy: Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and User Acquisition teams to interpret complex performance data, translate findings into strategic recommendations, and directly influence optimisation efforts.
 * Advanced Data Analysis & Modelling: Utilise strong SQL and Python skills to conduct sophisticated data analysis, build robust analytical models, and maintain relevant data structures that support predictive insights.
 * Insights Communication & Enablement: Transform complex analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders. Mentor and train teams on how to leverage these insights effectively, moving beyond basic reporting.
   
   

What You'll Bring 💡


 * Extensive experience (typically 4+ years) in a data analysis role with a strong focus on business performance, user behaviour, and growth metrics.
 * Proven experience with technical data analysis, statistics, A/B testing, data modelling and evaluation of algorithmic data solutions.
 * Exceptional proficiency in SQL and Python for complex data manipulation, analysis, and statistical modelling.
 * Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modelling principles relevant to analytical outcomes.
 * Experience in collaborating closely with marketing, product, and data science teams to drive measurable business impact.
 * Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, influencing data-driven decisions.
   
   

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟


 * A Predictive Mindset: You are passionate about uncovering future trends and user behaviour through data, using insights to drive proactive strategies.
 * Impact-Driven & Strategic: You're not just reporting numbers; you're using them to influence key business decisions and directly contribute to revenue and user growth.
 * Collaborative Analytical Partner: You excel at translating complex data into actionable strategies for business stakeholders, thriving in a cross-functional environment.
   
   

Why Almedia? 🎁


 * Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.
 * Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.
 * Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.
 * Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.
 * We Listen: We regularly add to our benefits through rigorous employee feedback.
   
   

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Founding Product Manager
description:
About The Role

A fast-growing, Y Combinator-backed B2B SaaS startup in the AI-powered industrial sales automation space is hiring its first Product Manager. This is a high-impact founding role where you will own the what and why behind an AI-first product — working directly alongside the CPO and engineering team to transform customer pain points into intuitive, high-adoption solutions. You will shape core workflows, drive measurable customer time savings, and help define the company's product direction from the ground up.

The company automates quote and order processes for distributors and manufacturers in sectors such as HVAC, building materials, and electrical, integrating with enterprise ERP systems (SAP, Oracle). The platform is growing quickly and has reached strong early revenue traction.

What You'll Do


 * Own the full product development cycle — from discovery through rollout — with a relentless focus on adoption and customer time savings.
 * Speak directly with customers to uncover problems and synthesize feedback from customers, internal teams, and the market.
 * Define and validate product hypotheses with customers; build rapid prototypes to test ideas quickly.
 * Translate customer insights into clear requirements and intuitive, AI-first product experiences designed for non-technical users.
 * Prioritize, scope, and ship new features in close collaboration with engineering and design.
 * Create and maintain product documentation, release notes, and training content to help customers get maximum value from new features.
 * Make complex B2B workflows effortless through thoughtful product decisions and iterative validation.
   
   

What We're Looking For

Required


 * 2–5 years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Designer with a strong track record in AI-first, complex B2B SaaS products.
 * Demonstrated ability to speak directly with customers and turn messy, qualitative feedback into crisp, actionable requirements.
 * Proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Lovable, Cursor, Claude) and prototyping tools such as Figma.
 * Experience owning end-to-end product development from discovery to rollout.
 * Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and design teams to prioritize and ship features.
 * Fluent in both German and English (required).
 * Based in Munich or willing to relocate for full on-site work (required — no remote option).
   
   

Nice To Have


 * Domain knowledge in AI-enabled software for technical suppliers or distributors in construction, HVAC, electrical, or related industrial sectors.
 * Coding familiarity with React, TypeScript, or Python to prototype independently or collaborate more closely with engineers.
   
   

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is based on-site in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. Candidates must be located in Munich or willing to relocate. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation details were not specified for this role. You will be joining as a founding team member with meaningful early-stage equity potential and the opportunity to have outsized impact on product direction at a well-backed startup.

title: Head of Product & IT
description:
Bei ubiMaster ermöglichen wir Schüler:innen einen live und unbegrenzten Zugang zu Nachhilfelehrer:innen – ganz nach unserer Vision: Bildung soll für alle zugänglich sein, unabhängig vom Einkommen oder sozialen Status der Eltern. 

Gegründet im Jahr 2018 und seither auf einem erfolgreichen Wachstumskurs, haben wir kürzlich unsere Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen. Nun bauen wir unser Unternehmen konsequent weiter aus. Dabei unterstützen wir einerseits Unternehmen, ihren Mitarbeitenden und deren Kindern durch maßgeschneiderte Bildungslösungen bestmögliche Perspektiven zu bieten. Andererseits helfen wir unseren Partnern, ihre Produkte und Dienstleistungen durch integrierte Bildungslösungen differenzierend im Markt zu positionieren. 

Zudem arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an innovativen Produktideen und setzen bereits erste Schritte in Richtung Internationalisierung – unter anderem nach Spanien, Österreich und in die Schweiz. 

Wenn Du Freude an Wachstum hast, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, Agilität schätzt und gleichzeitig einen gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert schaffen willst, dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns als: 

 

 

Head of Product & IT (m/w/d)
Arbeitsort: München / (Hybrid)

 

Deine Aufgaben:
 * End-to-End Produktverantwortung: Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team verantwortest Du die Entwicklung neuer sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte entlang der Produktroadmap. Du analysierst die technische Machbarkeit der Projekte und legst einen klaren Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit.
 * Engineering: Du setzt alle Vorhaben technisch mit Deinem Team um. Dabei triffst Du holistische Architekturentscheidungen und stellst uns so bestmöglich im Unternehmenssinn auf. Du musst dabei nicht selbst coden, aber den technischen Durchblick haben, um die richtigen strategischen Entscheidungen zu treffen.
 * Make or Buy: Du entscheidest Fall für Fall, was wir selbst machen und was wir extern an Technologiepartner outsourcen. Neben der Leitung des internen Teams koordinierst Du auch sämtliche externe Partner und Agenturen (Vendormanagement) und behältst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die Vertrags- und Leistungsbewertung im Blick.
 * Stabilität der IT-Landschaft: Zu jedem Zeitpunkt hast Du einen Blick darauf, dass unsere technische Organisation „gesund“ ist, sowohl was die Aufstellung der Abteilung, Infrastruktur und auch die IT-Security betrifft. Du stellst die zuverlässige Umsetzung aller IT Projekte sicher.
 * Führung: Du leitest Dein Team empathisch, entscheidest klar und kommunzierst effektiv mit Stakeholdern. Dabei setzt Du auf Agilität und stellst Leistung über Methoden.

Dein Profil:

title: Senior Director, Global Product (m/f/x)
description:
Who We Are

At Progyny Global, we’re on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide. As part of Progyny Inc., we combine world-class clinical expertise with groundbreaking technology to deliver inclusive, culturally competent support for families everywhere.




Your Mission




We are looking for a Senior Director, Global Product to define and lead the strategic direction of Progyny’s global product and service offering. This role sits on the global leadership team and is critical to shaping how we deliver best-in-class women’s and family health solutions across diverse international markets.

This is a rare opportunity for a product leader who can set a compelling long-term vision while remaining deeply hands-on - combining strategic thinking with medical or women’s health domain expertise, and the intuition to build meaningful, scalable user experiences in a complex, high-impact space.




This role is based in our Berlin office.




What You’ll Do




 * Own and articulate a clear, compelling global product vision for Progyny’s international markets, with a particular focus on advancing women’s and family health outcomes at scale.
 * Act as a thought leader in women’s and family health, leveraging deep knowledge of the global women’s health landscape to drive product innovation.
 * Champion the voice of the member and customer, translating real-world pain points into intuitive, high-impact product solutions.
 * Lead global product strategy across regulated healthcare systems and insurance-adjacent infrastructure, including claims, reimbursement and payments.
 * Facilitate alignment and decision-making across a broad group of stakeholders, including founders, Sales, Member Experience, Finance, Engineering, and Legal.
 * Drive end-to-end product ownership, from ideation and discovery through build, launch, and go-to-market execution.
 * Partner closely with Engineering and Design to deliver products that are scalable, intuitive, and held to a high bar for quality.
 * Maintain strong attention to detail and product craft, ensuring experiences reflect the sensitivity and complexity of women’s health journeys.




What You Bring




 * Degree in a relevant field, such as healthcare, life sciences, public health, medicine, health economics, business, or engineering, or equivalent experience in healthcare or health-tech product leadership.
 * Proven experience leading global product strategy in healthcare, health tech, benefits, or adjacent industries, with exposure to women’s health or femtech strongly preferred.
 * Strong understanding of the women’s health ecosystem, with the ability to credibly engage as a domain expert and thought leader.
 * Medical or clinical background strongly preferred, or equivalent experience working closely with medical teams and healthcare systems.
 * Alternatively, experience as a founder or early product leader in a women’s health or femtech startup.
 * Demonstrated experience navigating international healthcare requirements and regulatory complexity.
 * Solid understanding of insurance-adjacent product components, such as claims processing, reimbursements, and payment mechanisms.
 * Strong product sense with experience delivering multi-sided platforms and complex workflows.
 * Exceptional ability to influence, align, and facilitate across senior stakeholders in a fast-moving, global environment, with a consultative and structured approach.
 * Hands-on mindset with a track record of turning strategy into execution, ideally in high-growth or ambiguous environments.




Why Join Us




 * Competitive Base Salary: From €120,000 – €135,000 per year.
 * Bonus Program & Company Equity: Bonuses and ownership opportunities to share in Progyny’s success.
 * Fertility & Family-Building Benefits: Access to the Progyny Global Platform with a €5,000 benefits budget.
 * Mental Health Support: 1:1 psychologist sessions and wellness tools via Nilo Health.
 * Sustainable Mobility Benefit: Choice between a Dance e-bike subscription or a BVG public transport ticket.
 * Urban Sports Club Discount: Access to discounted fitness and wellness activities.
 * Paid Leave: 30 days of paid leave per year.
 * Hybrid Work: Work from home up to two days per week.
 * Remote Work: Up to 8 weeks of remote work per year.




We believe that great leaders come from diverse backgrounds. If you’re passionate about building high-performing teams, delivering world-class care, and shaping the future of global member experience, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Manager (Remote, Stuttgart, DE)
description:
APCOA – We combine parking, mobility and urban life. The APCOA Group is Europe's leading full-service parking manager with 50 years of industry expertise. The company lives international competence with experts from 12 European countries and has an extensive customer portfolio. The group manages around 1.5 million individual parking spaces at over 12,000 locations. The company's approximately 5,000 employees contribute their know-how and local expertise to offer excellent services to customers and business customers. APCOA's goal is to provide smart parking solutions that meet the needs of the modern, connected consumer by providing them with an equally connected parking garage. As a private equity-led company, we are pursuing an ambitious growth strategy and would like to take you with us on our path to digitalization as a

Senior Product Manager (m/f/d) Digital

Stuttgart or remote

Your Mission


 * As a Senior Product Manager in the Digital Products & Innovation division, you will actively shape the future of our digital parking products – with both hands. We are not looking for a strategist from the ivory tower, but a real doer: Someone who takes responsibility, tackles things and is not above completing tasks that are not in the classic senior PM textbook. With us, you will switch smoothly between roadmap workshop and ticket writing, between strategy deck and bug reproduction in app testing. You will be responsible for your own products and features end-to-end – from the initial idea to development and roll-out – and will make a significant contribution to APCOA further expanding its market leadership in the field of digital parking solutions.
 * You will:
 * take strategic and operational responsibility for selected digital products and features – and not just "take responsibility", but actively help shape, work and deliver
 * Independently develop, prioritize and further develop the product vision, roadmap and backlogs together with the Head of Product Management – including neatly written user stories, acceptance criteria and refinements that you prepare yourself
 * Identify, develop and implement innovative product ideas, optimizations and features – even if that means sketching a prototype in Figma yourself, conducting a competitor test or formulating a feature concept down to the smallest detail
 * Analyze product performance based on relevant KPIs – You build your dashboards and evaluations pragmatically yourself (basic SQL or analytics knowledge is worth its weight in gold here) instead of waiting for input
 * regularly test our apps and products ourselves, reproduce bugs, document feedback cleanly and sometimes listen in on the hotline or drive into the field to observe real users parking
 * Work closely with cross-functional teams from app development, marketing, sales, IT and operations and act as a central interface – even if you don't have a project manager at your side and organize appointments, minutes or status updates yourself
 * Coordinate implementation in coordination with other APCOA countries and international service providers – including annoying detailed work such as backlog maintenance, release notes or documentation updates
 * Participate in the selection and management of external partners and service providers, write briefings yourself and critically accept deliveries
 * Carry out continuous market, competition and trend analyses – for us, this also means: doing your own research, clicking through competitor apps yourself, compiling figures yourself
 * Leading junior colleagues professionally without withdrawing from operational work – You lead by demonstrating, not by delegating
   
   

You Have


 * Several years of relevant professional experience in digital product management, ideally in the B2C and/or B2B environment – and above all a strong hands-on mentality: You don't wait for tasks to come to you, but see what needs to be done and get started
 * The clear attitude that no topic is "below your pay grade": Whether it's backlog refinement, app store screenshot, testing session or stakeholder update – you take over what is needed at the moment instead of waiting for the perfect process
 * In-depth experience in agile working methods (Scrum, Kanban) as well as in the confident, daily use of tools such as Jira, Confluence or comparable – you write tickets yourself instead of having them written
 * very good knowledge in the development and scaling of digital products and platforms; Experience in app store management and a basic technical understanding (APIs, data flows, releases) are a clear plus
 * A degree in business informatics, business administration or a comparable course of study - or a comparable career that proves your ability to work in a structured way
 * strong analytical and conceptual skills, coupled with pragmatism: You would rather deliver an 80% solution this week than a 100% solution in three months
 * High implementation skills, initiative and entrepreneurial thinking – as well as the willingness to take care of uncomfortable or small-scale tasks yourself in case of doubt
 * Enthusiasm for digital business models, eCommerce and the use of modern technologies
 * Very good knowledge of German and English as well as an experienced handling of common tools and Office applications
   
   

What we are expressly not looking for: PowerPoint architects who paint strategies but never look at the code repo, the ticket system or the app. If "that's not my job" is your most common sentence, we don't fit together. If, on the other hand, you love what you do, and even the tenth click through a payment flow is not too stupid for you – then we should talk.

You Will Meet


 * Performance-related remuneration
 * Flexible working hours and home office options (work-life balance)
 * Positive working environment with flat hierarchies
 * Offers in occupational health management
 * Further development opportunities in an international group
 * Corporate benefits: discounts, discounts on various platforms
 * Free parking at the workplace and employee parking in APCOA parking garages
 * A great opportunity to help shape an interesting area
   
   

Have we aroused your interest? Then please use our online application form to send us your application documents, stating the earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.

title: Produktmanager (all genders) Banking & Financial Services
description:
Produktmanager (all genders) Banking & Financial Services


Über Nect 

Bei Nect machen wir Digitalisierung greifbar – und sicher. Wir entwickeln KI und biometriebasierte Lösungen rund um die digitale Identität und Signatur, sogenannte Vertrauensdienste. Klingt technisch? Ist es auch – aber vor allem richtig spannend! Denn unsere Technologien helfen dabei, Behörden und Unternehmen fit für die digitale Zukunft zu machen. Was uns antreibt: Wir wollen zeigen, wie einfach und sicher digital sein kann – und dabei neue Chancen für alle schaffen. Lust, mit uns die digitale Welt von morgen zu gestalten? 

Die Rolle:  

Banking und Financial Services ist einer der strategisch wichtigsten Wachstumsmärkte für Nect – und wir stehen am Beginn einer entscheidenden Skalierungsphase. Mit einem technisch ausgereiften, eIDAS-zertifizierten Produkt, über 17 Millionen Nutzern und klarer Marktvalidierung schaffen wir jetzt die Grundlage, um uns als bevorzugter Identitätspartner für Banken und Finanzinstitutionen in Europa zu etablieren. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du diesen Ausbau maßgeblich mit: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden zusammen, entwickelst die bankspezifische Produktstrategie weiter und übersetzt Marktanforderungen in eine umsetzbare Roadmap für unsere Engineering-Teams.



Deine Aufgaben 

 * End-to-end Ownership für das Vertical Banking & Financial Services  
 * Eigenständige Gespräche mit Bankkunden und potenziellen Partnern, Analyse ihrer Prozesse, Anforderungen und regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen  
 * Entwicklung eines tiefen Markt- und Kundenverständnisses, das maßgeblich unsere Produktentscheidungen prägt 
 * Erstellung einer datengetriebenen, bankspezifischen Feature-Roadmap und Priorisierung konsequent nach Business Impact 
 * Leitung und Koordination von Engineering, Design und Sales auf dem Weg zum Launch 
 * Aufbau eigener Prototypen und Konzepte – auch mit Hilfe von AI-Tools  
 * Repräsentation von Nect auf Branchenevents 



Dein Profil 

 * Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Manager in einem Startup oder Scaleup  
 * Nachweisliche Berührungspunkte mit dem Banken- oder Financial-Services-Umfeld  
 * Verständnis von relevanten Regulierungen im Kontext mit eIDAS 2.0 und der EUDI Wallet 
 * Tiefes Verständnis von API-Produkten und technischen Integrationsszenarien 
 * Sicherer Umgang mit AI-Tools (z.B. Claude Code, Cursor oder vergleichbaren) 
 * Ausgepräge Kundenorientierung und strategisches Denkvermögen

title: Chief of Staff
description:
This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Chief of Staff in Germany.

This is a high-impact strategic role designed for a highly analytical and execution-focused professional who thrives at the center of fast-moving business operations. Working closely with senior leadership, you will help drive company-wide alignment, operational excellence, and strategic execution across multiple business functions. The role combines executive partnership, cross-functional coordination, and operational leadership, offering direct exposure to key business decisions and high-priority initiatives. You will help transform ideas into action, manage critical projects, support executive communication, and ensure organizational priorities stay on track in a dynamic remote-first environment. Ideal candidates are exceptional communicators, highly organized problem-solvers, and comfortable navigating ambiguity while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. This opportunity offers significant visibility, ownership, and the chance to influence the growth and scalability of a rapidly evolving global technology business.

Accountabilities


 * Partner closely with executive leadership to drive strategic initiatives, operational priorities, and cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
 * Support the executive office by ensuring decisions translate into actionable next steps, clear ownership, accountability, and timely follow-through across teams.
 * Lead and coordinate high-impact special projects, including strategic reviews, internal transformation initiatives, executive reporting, and board preparation activities.
 * Develop executive-level communications and materials such as business reviews, board presentations, company-wide updates, and leadership reports.
 * Manage and optimize the company’s operating cadence, including leadership meetings, quarterly planning cycles, OKR tracking, and business performance reviews.
 * Collaborate with functional leaders to improve cross-team alignment, identify operational gaps, and proactively resolve issues before they escalate.
 * Support the adoption and integration of AI tools and workflows across teams by tracking implementation progress and identifying operational improvements.
 * Serve as a strategic connector between product, engineering, commercial, and operational functions to ensure efficient coordination and execution across the organization.
 * Maintain visibility into company-wide developments and ensure leadership teams remain informed on key risks, opportunities, and business signals.
   
   

Requirements


 * 4 to 5 years of experience in high-performance environments such as strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, fintech, SaaS, or fast-scaling technology companies.
 * Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.
 * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience preparing executive presentations, reports, and business narratives.
 * Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while operating effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
 * Strong organizational and project management capabilities with a demonstrated ability to execute independently and deliver results with minimal oversight.
 * Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet analysis, PowerPoint presentations, financial modeling, and data interpretation; SQL knowledge is considered a plus.
 * Familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation, and practical AI adoption strategies within business operations is highly desirable.
 * High level of discretion, judgment, and professionalism when handling sensitive organizational or commercial information.
 * Intellectual curiosity and adaptability with the ability to switch seamlessly between strategic, operational, financial, and technical topics.
 * Previous experience within B2B SaaS, fintech, payments infrastructure, or startup environments is advantageous.
   
   

Benefits


 * Fully remote work environment with global collaboration opportunities.

 * Flexible and uncapped paid time off with a minimum encouraged usage policy.
 * Access to co-working spaces and remote work support resources.
 * Company retreats, workations, and team-building events designed to strengthen collaboration and culture.

 * Inclusive, collaborative, and mission-driven culture focused on innovation, flexibility, and professional development.

title: Senior Product Designer (Europe, remote)
description:
A Little About Us

 * Rapid growth: Millions of users within just two years of launch

Learn more: www.kittl.com/career

Your role at Kittl

You will own design across one of Kittl's core product surfaces (editor, AI, or growth), shaping the experiences that turn first-time consumer and prosumer users into repeat creators. Reporting to the Head of Product Design, you'll set the craft bar for your area and operate as a peer to PM and Engineering, bringing user evidence and a strong point of view to every roadmap conversation. Your work will directly influence activation, retention, and the quality of the AI-assisted creation experience millions of creators depend on. You'll move from research to shipped product without handoffs, and your decisions will compound across the platform.

What You'll Do


 * Own end-to-end design: Take full ownership of a core product area from problem framing and research through shipping, measurement, and iteration
 * Drive initiatives forward: Take a clear position on product direction and actively unblock the team when momentum stalls
 * Raise the craft bar: Hold a high quality standard in your work and elevate it through critique and pairing with peers, raising the bar across flows, components, and AI-driven interactions
 * Translate constraints into decisions: Convert user behaviour, business needs, and technical constraints into clear design decisions you can articulate to any audience
 * Lead complex features: Design sophisticated product features and user journeys with high visual and interaction craft
 * Build reusable patterns: Contribute to Kittl's AI patterns and design system through the features you ship
   
   

What You'll Need


 * Experience: Minimum 6 years designing digital products, with at least 2 years shipping consumer or prosumer products at scale
 * Portfolio: Strong portfolio showing end-to-end ownership including research, interaction design, visual craft, and shipped outcomes you can point to
 * AI design experience: Hands-on experience designing for AI-driven or generative product surfaces, or a strong track record that translates to it
 * Productive disagreement skills: Track record of disagreeing well and committing fully - holding positions with evidence and moving forward decisively once a call is made

Interview process

We are looking for someone

Benefits

title: Product Marketer
description:
About The Role

A fast-growing enterprise AI SaaS platform is looking for a Product Marketer to sit between product and market — translating frequent releases into clear positioning, compelling stories, and sales-ready materials. This role is central to shaping how customers and prospects understand the platform's capabilities as the product and category evolve. You'll work closely with product, sales, customer success, and design in a high-ownership, cross-functional environment.

What You'll Do


 * Own go-to-market plans for every meaningful product release and execute them across the right channels.
 * Turn product releases into compelling narratives that explain why new features matter to buyers.
 * Develop and maintain positioning that differentiates the product for different buyer personas and markets (e.g., enterprise IT leaders vs. AI leads).
 * Create clear product content: comparison pages, capability overviews, one-pagers, and campaign explainers.
 * Work directly with customers, support tickets, and sales calls to surface what users value and translate it into messaging.
 * Enable sales and customer success teams with framing, materials, and answers to difficult product questions.
 * Help define category positioning for enterprise AI as the market and product evolve.
   
   

What We're Looking For

Required


 * 3+ years in product marketing, with a track record of delivering end-to-end go-to-market for software features or products.
 * Demonstrated ability to own and execute launches across multiple channels — planning, messaging, and activation.
 * Excellent writing skills with a focus on clarity over cleverness; ability to explain technical products simply to non-technical audiences.
 * Comfortable participating in product reviews and engaging with engineering without needing to be a developer.
 * Habit of conducting customer research — conversations, support tickets, sales calls — and translating findings into marketing assets.
 * Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across product, design, marketing, sales, and customer success.
 * Ownership mindset: bias to drive problems end-to-end rather than waiting for a brief.
   
   

Nice To Have


 * Experience using AI tools for research, drafting, and content synthesis as part of your regular workflow.
 * Familiarity targeting or marketing to German enterprise IT buyers or the German Mittelstand market.
 * Willingness to appear on camera or participate in public-facing demos and presentations.
   
   

The Opportunity

This is an early, high-impact product marketing role at a Seed-funded enterprise AI platform that is scaling rapidly across European markets. The company is security-first, model-agnostic, and focused on enabling large organizations to adopt AI safely. You'll have real ownership over category narrative and positioning at an exciting stage of growth.

Location

This role is based on-site in Berlin, Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available — candidates must already have the right to work in Germany.

title: Senior Conversion & Product Analyst (all genders)
description:
Welcome to Glow25!

We are a dynamic, fast-growing beauty and pro-aging company based in Berlin.

Our heartfelt mission: Glow moments that last — for our community and for us as a team.

Work at Glow25 should inspire, excite, and be fun. That’s why we’re looking for smart, empathetic people who take ownership and grow with us.

Join Glow25 and help us redefine beauty. We’re excited to meet you!

These are our current challenges and future goals:

At Glow25, we’re looking for a Conversion & Product Analyst to join our central Data team and help us deeply understand how users interact with our websites. You’ll support Product Managers and the Marketing team by driving insight generation, owning our conversion tracking setup, and enabling high-quality decision-making through data.

This role blends strong analytical thinking with solid technical skills. You'll work across the full data stack - from setting up tracking to delivering insights - and play a key role in shaping how we measure and improve the customer journey.

This is where we need your support:


 * Partner with Product and Marketing: Work closely with Product Managers and Marketers to define success metrics, evaluate experiments, and generate actionable insights.
 * Build and Maintain the Funnel: Own a sophisticated conversion funnel setup that connects user behavior across platforms and channels.
 * Tracking & Instrumentation: Contribute to event tracking design, including server-side tracking, to ensure reliable and privacy-compliant data collection.
 * Campaign Analysis: Help the Marketing team understand campaign performance, user acquisition quality, and channel effectiveness.
 * Collaborate with CRM: Partner with the CRM team to deliver insights across subscriptions, newsletter performance, refer-a-friend, and loyalty programs to optimize retention and customer lifetime value.
 * Data Modeling & Engineering: Use SQL and dbt to model clean, usable datasets that power dashboards and ad-hoc analysis.
 * Proactive Analysis: Identify trends, user behaviors, and opportunities for product or marketing improvement - without always being asked.
 * Enable Self-Serve: Help build a culture of data access by creating clear documentation, training materials, and intuitive self-service data sets in Lightdash.
   
   

You have the following experience:


 * You have 3+ years in product analytics roles, ideally across both product and marketing analytics.
 * Proven skills in event tracking (client-side and server-side), product instrumentation, and campaign analysis.
 * Strong command of SQL (Python is an advantage) and experience working with cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
 * Advanced knowledge of GTM and GA4.
 * Experience with Shopify is a strong advantage
 * You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and independently driving clarity.
 * Demonstrated sense of ownership and proactive problem-solving skills.
 * Proficiency in English is required
   
   

That's something you can look forward to:


 * Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.
 * Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.
 * Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.
 * Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.
 * Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.
 * Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.
 * Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!
 * Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.
 * Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.
 * Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.
 * Team spirit to go. Our Glow25 merch is more than just fabric – it’s your badge of belonging.
 * Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.
 * Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.
   
   

Yay! You've made it this far!

But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

title: Product Marketing Manager (Berlin)
description:
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We have already set the standard for AI-powered contract review, helping teams work with greater precision than ever before. But that is just the beginning. We are building a holistic platform that goes far beyond review - connecting people, ideas, and knowledge to fundamentally change how legal teams operate.

When you join Legartis, you don’t just take a job - you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and legal experts who believe that true problem-solving requires more than just code; it requires a thoughtful process. We don't chase hype; we build substance. If you’re a tech savvy product marketer who understands the audience and fuels growth through product marketing, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact in an emerging industry.

Ready to build great things together?

Please submit your CV along with a Cover Letter outlining your Ambition to join Legartis. Applications without a Cover Letter will not be accepted.

Your mission

You shape how Legartis wins in the market:


 * Make our products clearly differentiated and highly competitive - by developing and continuously sharpening positioning and messaging across our portfolio.
 * Drive go-to-market strategy and execution for launches, expansion, and adoption - from plan to impact.
 * Find market opportunities others miss - deep knowledge of our ICP, competitive landscape, and buyer needs isn't just insight work, it's how you shape what we build and how we sell it.
 * Arm every team to win - create the assets, narratives, and enablement materials that make Sales, Marketing, and CS more effective.
 * Feed product strategy with market truth - bring customer and competitive intelligence back to the product team so we build what matters.
 * Work across the company, not in a silo - you sit in Product, but your influence reaches Marketing, Sales, and leadership.
   
   

Your profile


 * 4+ years in marketing, growth, product marketing, or product management at a SaaS company. Creativity matters more than a traditional background.
 * Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.
 * Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.
 * Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.
 * Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.
 * AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.
 * Fluent in English and German.
 * Nice to have: previous experience in legal tech.
 * You are warm, pragmatic, and naturally curious. You ask the right questions, communicate clearly, and have a bias toward action. You are a true team player who elevates the people around you.
   
   

Why us?


 * Shape the future of Legal Tech in an emerging market building an impactful AI product.
 * Opportunity to work self organised and add to technology as well as features.
 * Work with a talented and dedicated team of researchers and engineers. Here you can make an impact and grow professionally.
 * Competitive salary and participation of the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).
 * Modern office in Leipzig with at least 2 days per week in the office or hybrid in Berlin.
 * Regular team events in Zurich, Leipzig and offsite like restaurant testing, hiking and more.
   
   

Process

Our process is built on respect and transparency:


 * 30 min. interview with People & Operations Manager (cultural fit): Have a chat to get an understanding of Legartis and the role you are interested in. We in turn want to get to know you and your expectations of your next challenge.
 * 20 min. interview with Head of Product (professional fit): Understand the professional requirements for this position better, as well as your future tasks and team setup.
 * 1h interview with Product and Marketing teams (case study): To demonstrate your abilities, you have an in-depth interview with our product team. You showcase your abilities by presenting a real life use case in product marketing.
 * Additional interviews: Meet the team you would be working with and take the opportunity to pose any remaining questions. One meeting will be in our Leipzig office to meet the team in person and get to know the work place.
 * Decision is made: If we’re considering each other to be the right fit, you are welcomed by the Legartis team!
   
   

About Us

We are Legartis, a LegalTech company that is changing the way contracts are reviewed and analyzed today. Our SaaS solution uses artificial intelligence to automate contract review for legal departments and law firms. We are a growing and ambitious team on a mission to eliminate repetitive tasks in everyday legal work. Since our founding in 2017, we have won various awards such as the Swiss Fintech Awards, been listed as a Top100 startup in Switzerland and named by Forbes as one of the best AI startups in the DACH region.

title: Product Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Product Manager (w/m/d) bei LapID Service GmbH

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Muttersprachliches Niveau

🛠️ Und dieses Profil bringst Du mit:


 * Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder in einem vergleichbaren Bereich
 * Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Produktmanagement, in der Softwareentwicklung, im UI/UX Design oder im Bereich digitaler Lerninhalte gesammelt
 * Idealerweise hast Du bereits Erfahrung mit Articulate 360, anderen Autorentools oder digitalen Lerninhalten
 * Du verfügst über sehr gute konzeptionelle und analytische Fähigkeiten
 * Dir gelingt es, Anforderungen, Bedürfnisse und Lösungsideen strukturiert zu ermitteln und zusammenzuführen
 * Du erkennst schnell Zusammenhänge und arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und selbstständig
 * Du bist kommunikativ, arbeitest gerne im Team und bewegst Dich sicher zwischen fachlichen, technischen und organisatorischen Themen
   
   

Auch wenn nicht alle Punkte 100% auf Dich zutreffen, kann es dennoch die optimale Position für Dich sein! Daher freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

📬 Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Nachricht über den Instaffo Chat!

Tätigkeiten

👇 Diese Aufgaben warten auf Dich:

Als Produktmanager (w/m/d) für den Bereich Compliance & Learnings erwarten Dich an unserem Headquarter in Netphen oder in unserem Kölner Office spannende Aufgaben und ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung in einem jungen und dynamischen Umfeld.


 * Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für Deine Produkte und stehst im engen Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern aus verschiedenen Bereichen und Unternehmensebenen – von Entwicklung bis Management
 * Du verantwortest das Anforderungsmanagement und bewertest fachliche Anforderungen hinsichtlich Aufwand, Nutzen und Machbarkeit
 * Gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam planst Du die Weiterentwicklung Deiner Produkte, pflegst und priorisierst das Backlog und übernimmst in Review-Meetings die Rolle des Product Owners
 * Du analysierst Markt, Kundenbedürfnisse und Trends und entwickelst daraus fundierte Konzepte und neue Produktideen
 * Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen aus Produktmanagement, Vertrieb und Entwicklung zusammen, um neue Features und Lösungen erfolgreich in die Umsetzung zu bringen
 * Du verantwortest die Konzeption, Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lern- und Unterweisungsmodule in Articulate 360
 * Du entwickelst den Bereich Learning Content gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern strategisch weiter und sorgst für eine fachlich, didaktisch und produktspezifisch überzeugende Umsetzung
   
   

In der Rolle als Product Manager (w/m/d) wirst Du eng mit Tim Wiersdörfer zusammenarbeiten.

Team

🤝 Du arbeitest eng mit Deinen zwei Kolleg:innen und unserem Abteilungsleiter zusammen. Zusätzlich unterstützt Euch eine Werkstudentin.

Über das Unternehmen

Als SaaS-Anbieter sorgen wir dafür, dass Arbeitgeber in Deutschland ein entspannteres Leben haben. Wir schrecken nicht vor schwierigen Compliance-Themen zurück, sondern suchen nach innovativen Wegen, gesetzliche Anforderungen automatisiert zu erfüllen. Mit unseren Lösungen wie der elektronischen Führerscheinkontrolle, E-Learning Unterweisungen und digitalem Dokumentenmanagement sind bereits über 3.000 Kunden wie Coca-Cola, Evonik und Innocent auf der sicheren Seite und können sich auf das Wesentliche fokussieren.

Warum LapID?

Als Erfinder der elektronischen Führerscheinkontrolle sind wir seit 2006 auf dem Markt. All die Erfahrung, die wir bereits in der Fuhrparkbranche gesammelt haben und weiterhin sammeln, lassen wir in die Entwicklung unserer Produkte einfließen. Gemeinsam mit Ihnen entwickeln wir rechtssichere und lückenlose Prozesse zur Führerscheinkontrolle, Fahrerunterweisung und Fahrzeugprüfung, die die individuellen Anforderungen Ihres Fuhrparks erfüllen. Unser Wissen im Bereich E-Learning weiten wir dabei auf zusätzliche Unterweisungsthemen im Unternehmen aus und bieten somit die Komplettlösung für jedes Unternehmen, das den Anforderungen der Deutschen Gesetzlichen Unfallversicherung (DGUV) nachkommen möchte. Dabei stehen wir Ihnen ab dem ersten Tag mit unserer persönlichen Beratung zur Seite.

Wir schaffen Raum für wichtigere Dinge

Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2006 bestimmen unsere Kunden unser tägliches Handeln. Ihr Bedürfnis nach einer einfachen, sicheren und automatisierten Lösung zur Führerscheinkontrolle führte zur Geburtsstunde von LapID. Seitdem entwickeln wir innovative Compliance-Lösungen für Fuhrparks und sind damit Marktführer. Über 3.000 Kunden und mehr als 300.000 Fahrer vertrauen uns.

Wir werden vom Wunsch angetrieben, dass unsere Kunden ihre rechtlichen Anforderungen an die Führerscheinkontrolle und Fahrerunterweisung zweifelsfrei erfüllen und dabei kaum noch etwas selbst machen müssen. So haben unsere Kunden mehr Zeit, sich um den Erfolg ihres Unternehmens zu kümmern.

Innovation „Made in Germany“

Von unseren Standorten im Siegerland und in Köln aus entwickeln wir unsere Produkte zusammen mit unserer Schwesterfirma INVERS ständig weiter. LapID ist Teil der Holdinggesellschaft Fleet Technology. Diese vereint die Themen Mobilität, Shareconomy und Internet der Dinge.

Die Motivation unserer Kollegen in der Software- und Hardwareentwicklung spiegelt sich in unserer kontinuierlichen Produktentwicklung wider. Unsere Innovationskraft wurde bereits mehrfach prämiert. So konnten wir beispielsweise im Jahr 2014 die Auszeichnung als „TOP Innovator“ feiern. Im Jahr 2017 haben wir die Jury des INNOVATIONSPREIS-IT mit der „LapID Driver App“ als eine der besten Apps überzeugt. Diese Auszeichnungen sehen wir als Ansporn auch in Zukunft mit zukunftsweisenden Entwicklungen zu überzeugen.

Klicke auf "Bewerben" für Details zu den Benefits, dem Team und dem Bewerbungsprozess.

title: Product Owner
description:
Projektkapitän gesucht: Du hast Erfahrung mit der Planung und Umsetzung größerer Web, CMS & E-Commerce Projekte sowie der Integration von Online-Lösungen in Geschäftsprozessen. Wenn du nicht nur Spaß daran hast, agile Projekte zu leiten, sondern auch gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und dem Entwicklungsteam exzellente Web-Lösungen zu konzipieren, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung!


Aufgaben

   
   
 * Schmiede den Plan: Du verantwortest anspruchsvolle Web, CMS & E-Commerce Projekte, begleitest diese von der Angebotsphase bis zur Endabnahme und organisierst diese in agilen Methoden.
