title: UX/UI designer
description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
 * Shape high-leverage product experiences. Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful.
 * Start with an LLM. Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction.
 * Prototype and build with AI. Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result.
 * Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one. Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions.
 * Validate and measure. Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next.
 * Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog. Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver.
   
   

What we look for
 * Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
 * Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
 * Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
 * Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.
   
   

What we offer
 * Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
 * An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
 * Competitive pay and access to equity in the company. Typically, we offer individuals at the start of their career an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
 * All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
   
   

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland) or remote in selected countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we recommend spending your first few months working from our Milan office, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from our offices in Milan or London, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Advisory Board Member – Hedge Funds, Asset Management & Institutional Investing
description:
Company Description

Phantom Hedge is building the next generation of AI-native risk intelligence infrastructure for hedge funds and asset managers.

Our flagship product, Phantom RiskOS, helps investment teams understand, interpret, and act on risk in real time. Rather than relying solely on historical analytics and static risk reports, RiskOS combines market regimes, volatility dynamics, stress testing, portfolio decomposition, and predictive risk intelligence to support adaptive decision-making under changing market conditions.

Our mission is to help investment managers separate signal from noise, distinguish idiosyncratic opportunities from systematic exposures, and make more informed portfolio and risk management decisions in increasingly complex markets.




Role Description

Phantom Hedge is seeking an experienced industry professional to join our Advisory Board and support the company's market validation and early go-to-market efforts.

In the initial phase, the advisor will help Phantom Hedge engage with hedge fund CIOs, portfolio managers, risk managers, COOs, and asset management leaders to validate market requirements, refine our ideal customer profile, and identify potential design partners.

As the company progresses, the advisor may also support strategic positioning, industry partnerships, and fundraising activities.

Responsibilities include:

 * Facilitating introductions to hedge funds, asset managers, and relevant industry stakeholders
 * Supporting customer discovery and market validation interviews
 * Providing feedback on industry workflows, operational challenges, and risk management practices
 * Assisting in identifying and developing design-partner opportunities
 * Advising on market positioning and product direction
 * Supporting strategic growth initiatives as Phantom Hedge scales




Qualifications

 * Significant experience within hedge funds, asset management, institutional investing, prime brokerage, or financial services
 * Established professional network among CIOs, portfolio managers, risk managers, investment teams, or asset management executives
 * Strong understanding of portfolio construction, risk management, trading, or investment operations
 * Ability to provide strategic industry insight and challenge assumptions constructively
 * Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
 * Previous advisory, executive, business development, or leadership experience is advantageous
 * Interest in shaping the future of AI-driven risk intelligence for investment management




Compensation

 * Equity-based advisory position
 * Flexible time commitment (typically 2–4 hours per month)
 * Equity structure determined based on experience, network, and expected contribution

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own technical direction across one of three product surfaces — the vCluster platform, vNode, or vMetal. You'll partner directly with the Head of Product and Engineering leadership on the decisions that shape where the product goes next. This role requires core working hours that overlap with both US Eastern and Central European time zones (approximately 9 AM–1 PM ET / 3–9 PM CET).

Your Role as a Senior Product Manager


 * Technical Roadmap Ownership: Set the roadmap for your product surface and translate strategy into specs engineering can execute against. We'll align scope to your background — a hyperscaler KaaS PM might own the vCluster platform, a bare metal or GPU cloud PM might own vMetal, a multi-tenancy specialist might own platform + vNode.
 * Founder Partnership: Work directly with the Head of Product and Engineering leadership on the architecture tradeoffs that determine the product's trajectory.
 * Hands-on Validation: Run alpha and beta builds yourself. Catch integration issues before customers do.
 * Customer Intelligence: Engage directly with platform engineers at AI Cloud operators, regulated enterprises, and large internal platform teams. The next zero-to-one comes from these conversations.
 * Market Positioning: Track the cloud-native ecosystem and emerging tenancy primitives. Sharpen the narrative for technical buyers and partner with GTM on messaging that lands.
 * Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge engineering, sales, and marketing so what we ship matches how we sell and support it.
   
   

This Role is a Fit for You if You Bring


 * Experience: 6+ years in product management, in cloud infrastructure, platform services, or distributed systems. You've shipped something other engineers depend on in production.
 * Kubernetes Fluency: You operate at the implementation level — controllers, CRDs, API machinery, admission webhooks — not just as a user.
 * Customer-Facing Infra Experience: You've sat across from platform engineers and architects, and you're comfortable in that conversation.
   
   

Bonus Points For


 * Kubernetes-as-a-Service: Built a KaaS offering at a cloud provider, vendor, or large internal platform team.
 * AI & MLOps Infrastructure: GPU scheduling, multi-tenant accelerator workloads, LLM deployment patterns.
 * Internal Developer Platforms: Platform PM experience building IDPs that abstract infrastructure complexity for developer teams.
 * Bare Metal & HPC: Worked with or built for bare metal infrastructure or high-performance computing environments.
 * Startup Growth: Navigated a Series A through C scaling phase.
   
   

About VCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. title: VP Marketing
description:

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

You’ll build and scale a modern, AI-enabled marketing engine that delivers measurable revenue impact, strengthens our competitive positioning, and elevates Jimdo’s authority in the AI-powered SaaS space.

This is a high-visibility leadership role with direct influence on company-wide strategy and growth.

Your Impact


 * Define and execute a global marketing strategy aligned with revenue and company OKRs
 * Own product positioning, messaging, pricing narratives, and competitive differentiation
 * Lead go-to-market strategy for new features, AI capabilities, and market expansions
 * Build and scale an AI-driven demand generation engine across paid, SEO, partnerships, lifecycle, and PLG
 * Align closely with Sales, RevOps, Product, and CS to optimize full-funnel performance (acquisition → retention → expansion)
 * Strengthen Jimdo’s brand voice and thought leadership in AI-enabled SaaS and small business enablement
 * Lead, coach, and grow a distributed marketing team of 15–20 across growth, content, product marketing, brand, and operations
 * Own the marketing budget, attribution models, dashboards, and performance forecasting
   
   

What You Bring


 * 12+ years of progressive marketing experience in SaaS (B2C or PLG environments preferred)
 * 4+ years in a senior marketing leadership role
 * Proven track record of scaling revenue through demand generation and strong product marketing
 * Deep understanding of PLG models and modern SaaS funnel metrics (CAC, LTV, conversion, retention, expansion ARR)
 * Experience integrating AI and automation into marketing strategy and experimentation

 * Strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term vision and hands-on execution

description:

A fast-growing, seed-funded European AI platform company is looking for an AI Marketing Operations Engineer to design and run the systems that make a small marketing team operate like a much larger one. You'll build production-ready skills, automations, pipelines, and lightweight internal interfaces that the entire team depends on daily. Your work will also serve as a living proof point for how AI can transform real workflows — with direct visibility into product development.

This is an on-site role based in Berlin, Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available.

What You'll Do


 * Build and maintain AI-powered marketing tools — including brand voice assistants, research tools, brief generators, and campaign reviewers — to production-quality standards with strong user adoption.
 * Keep internal documentation AI-ready by structuring and maintaining knowledge bases in GitHub for reliable agent consumption.

Required (dealbreakers)

Also Required


 * Track record structuring and maintaining documentation or knowledge bases (e.g., GitHub) so they are consumable by AI agents.

title: Head of Partnerships - Integrations & Applications
description:
About Trackunit

Trackunit is a fast-growing, leading provider of IoT and telematics solutions for the global construction industry, operating out of offices worldwide. At the heart of our platform is IrisX — a purpose-built data and AI platform that connects machines, people, and systems to drive real-time, actionable insights across the construction ecosystem.

 * Ensure integrations compound into reusable marketplace connectors, building long-term platform stickiness
   
   

Cross-Functional Pod Leadership


 * Lead and develop a cross-functional Integrations & Applications pod, including a dedicated Partnerships Product Manager, Platform Engineer, Field Marketing Manager, and Regional Partnership Managers as the function scales globally
 * Operate a disciplined weekly cadence across the pod, with structured interlocks into P&E and GTM leadership
 * Work closely with Platform Engineering to ensure IrisX is built for partners to extend, not just consume — including AI agent compatibility and self-serve developer onboarding
 * Collaborate with the Platform Partnerships Lead (embedded in Product) to formally prioritise integration demand within the P&E roadmap
   
   

Partner Pipeline & GTM


 * Build and manage a structured integration partner pipeline, with clear qualification criteria, engagement stages, and commercial terms
 * Lead co-sell and co-marketing motions globally with Field Marketing, with a clear path to building out and leading Regional Partnership Managers as the function grows
 * Drive partner onboarding through the IrisX marketplace and developer portal, with a focus on low-touch, scalable activation
 * Work alongside the Head of Partnerships and GTM leadership to align partner-sourced pipeline with direct sales motions
   
   

Platform & Marketplace


 * Actively contribute to the IrisX Marketplace strategy — ensuring integrations are discoverable, adoptable, and commercially visible to customers and partners
 * Partner with Developer Experience Engineering to improve sandbox environments, API documentation, and self-serve onboarding for ISVs and enterprise software partners
 * Represent partner integration demand in internal P&E discussions, ensuring Trackunit’s platform evolves in line with ecosystem needs
   
   

Qualifications


 * 10+ years of experience in partnerships, platform integrations, business development, or product roles within enterprise software, SaaS, or IoT environments
 * Demonstrated track record of building and scaling integration partnership programs — from pipeline and scoping through to live, revenue-generating deployments
 * Strong cross-functional leadership experience: able to lead without direct authority across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams
 * Commercial acumen: understands how integrations translate into platform consumption, ARR, and ecosystem defensibility
 * Experience working with ERP, fleet management, ConTech, or related enterprise software ecosystems is a strong advantage
 * Excellent communication and executive presence — able to engage confidently with C-suite partners and internal senior stakeholders
 * Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with a strong bias for action and structured thinking
 * Experience with marketplace platforms, developer portals, or partner-facing product surfaces is highly valued
 * Comfortable working remotely and operating across global time zones; this is a globally-scoped role with the opportunity to build and lead a regional org over time
   
   

Why This Role

IrisX is positioned to become the platform layer of the global construction industry. This role is one of the most strategically important hires in the IrisX Acceleration plan — the person who turns ecosystem ambition into shipped integrations, live consumption, and a partner network that compounds over time.

You will operate with real ownership, a cross-functional team, and executive visibility — and you will have the opportunity to shape how the construction industry’s leading IoT platform opens up to the wider ecosystem.

Our Hiring Process

Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.


 * Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other a bit better.
 * Virtual meet and greet. Meet with XXX
 * Personality-based interview. You will be asked to fill out an online personality assessment using use Hogan prior to the interview. Our Hogan assessment enables us to understand your abilities and how you align with our team culture. Instead of seeking 'appropriate' responses, the priority is to develop a meaningful exchange that illustrates your synergy with the Trackunit team.
 * Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.
 * If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.
 * Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!
   
   

Coming Together To Connect Construction

We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider, but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Market Insight and Strategy: Deeply cultivate the German consumer market and industrial belts (such as the Bavarian kitchenware industrial belt and the North Rhine-Westphalia maternal and infant industrial belt), analyze the trends of Germany's advantageous categories, competitor dynamics, and Chinese users' demand for German products, and formulate local direct sourcing and merchandising plans for Germany.

Possess high-quality resources such as local German brands, factories, chain supermarket suppliers, and German cross-border e-commerce sellers, and be familiar with the distribution of German industrial belts.

title: Product Growth Manager – Wertgutachten (m/w/d)

Product Growth Manager – Wertgutachten (m/w/d) bei CERTA GmbH

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Fließend


 * Erfahrung im Growth Marketing, Business Development oder einer vergleichbar kommerziell ausgerichteten Rolle
 * Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und datenbasierte Arbeitsweise
 * Vertriebsverständnis und ein gutes Gespür für überzeugende Kundenkommunikation
 * Unternehmerisches Denken verbunden mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

 * Affinität zu digitalen Tools (CRM, Analytics, Ads-Plattformen) – technische Vorkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich
 * Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für messbare wirtschaftliche Ergebnisse zu übernehmen
   
   

Nice to have (kein Muss):


 * Erfahrung im Immobilien‑ oder Bewertungsumfeld
   
   

Tätigkeiten

Diese Rolle ist keine klassische Managementstelle, Sie sind der intern, vollumfänglich Verantwortliche unseres meistgefragten Produkts. Bei CERTA bewerten wir nicht nur Immobilien: Wir machen Bewertungen für Tausende von Privatkunden, Unternehmen und Institutionen verlässlich, schnell und transparent zugänglich. Als Product Growth Manager verantworten Sie, dass dieser Anspruch wirtschaftlich funktioniert, von der ersten Anzeige bis zum abgeschlossenen Auftrag.

Marketing & Conversion


 * Sie steuern gezielt Werbekampagnen (Google Ads, Social Media) und optimieren kontinuierlich Landingpages, um aus Besuchern qualifizierte Anfragen zu machen, nicht nur Klicks zu generieren
 * Sie identifizieren, welche Botschaften welche Zielgruppen ansprechen, und entwickeln die Kampagnenstrategie entsprechend weiter
   
   

Lead-Management & Sales


 * Sie definieren, was eine qualifizierte Anfrage ausmacht, und stellen sicher, dass das Sales-Team nur mit Leads arbeitet, die echtes Abschlusspotenzial haben
 * Sie entwickeln Gesprächsleitfäden und Angebotsvorlagen, werten Vertriebsgespräche systematisch aus und leiten daraus konkrete Verbesserungen ab
   
   

Abschluss & P&L

 * Sie führen eine eigene Produkt-P&L, monitoren alle relevanten KPIs und berichten direkt an die Geschäftsführung
   
   

Team

Wir sind ein Kernteam von aktuell 24 Festangestellten und dahinter ein Netzwerk von über 180 externen Spezialisten, die deutschlandweit Objekte dokumentieren und bewerten. Was uns antreibt: Wachstum mit Substanz. Wir skalieren konsequent, ohne dabei zu vergessen, dass hinter jedem Teammitglied auch ein Mensch mit Familie und Leben steht.

Bei CERTA sind kurze Entscheidungswege kein Versprechen auf dem Papier, sie sind gelebter Alltag. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, bekommst echten Gestaltungsspielraum und wirst an Ergebnissen gemessen, nicht an Anwesenheit.

Der Hauptsitz ist in Köln und genau dort solltest du mindestens zweimal pro Woche vor Ort sein. Die restlichen Tage kannst du flexibel im Homeoffice arbeiten. Wir wissen, dass gute Arbeit nicht an einen festen Schreibtisch gebunden ist.

Über das Unternehmen

CERTA – als Arbeitgeber attraktiv...

Bei CERTA gestaltest du nicht nur mit – du prägest die Zukunft: Wir sind ein wachsendes, dynamisches Team von aktuell rund 25 Festangestellten, das zusätzlich von fachkundigen Freiberuflern im Außendienst professionell unterstützt wird. Unsere Mission: Immobilienbewertungen bundesweit schnell, transparent und verlässlich machen – und dabei als Arbeitgeber durch Klarheit, Teamgeist und digitale Kompetenz herausragen.


 * Teamfirst-Kultur – kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien und offene Türen zeichnen uns aus. Deine Ideen finden bei uns wertvollen Raum – und werden strukturiert umgesetzt.
 * Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit – du profitierst von der geballten Expertise aus Marketing, Technik, Gutachten-Fachwissen und strategischer Führungskompetenz durch die Geschäftsführung.
 * Gestaltungsspielraum – als Experte in deinem Bereich startest du in einer Position, in der du deine Rolle und Prozesse von Anfang an mitprägen kannst.
 * Wachstum im Fokus – wir expandieren bewusst weiter. Damit eröffnen sich immense Chancen für persönliche Entwicklung und nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg – du bist von Beginn an Teil davon.

title: Knowledge & Enablement Specialist
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About The Role

We’re looking for a versatile, high-craft Knowledge & Enablement Specialist to help build and maintain the content and learning experiences that support customer adoption at Synthesia.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of content development, knowledge management, product education, and enablement operations. You’ll create, publish, and improve content in our Academy, making sure customers and internal teams can find the right answer, learn the right workflow, and move forward with confidence. This is a builder role for someone who loves turning complex product and workflow changes into clear, usable, well-structured experiences.

What You’ll Do

Own Academy publishing and learner flow

Create, publish, and maintain customer-facing Academy content, modules, paths, and supporting learning experiences.

Ensure Academy content is structured clearly, tagged correctly, QA’d thoroughly, and published with a consistently high quality bar.

Improve learner flow and findability through better naming, placement, sequencing, navigation, and cross-linking within the Academy.

Build high-quality learning content

Translate product workflows, feature changes, and customer use cases into clear, accurate, engaging Academy content.

Create learning assets across formats, including written guidance, modules, video, demos, and supporting multimedia.

Tailor content to different audiences and use cases while keeping the experience clear, practical, and easy to apply.

Make the Academy the front door to learning

Ensure Academy pathways surface the right supporting resources from across the wider enablement ecosystem.

Use thoughtful cross-linking and content design to connect learners to the most relevant knowledge base, in-app, or other supporting resources when needed, without making the Academy feel fragmented or duplicative.

Identify gaps, overlap, or taxonomy issues early and raise recommendations that improve the overall learner experience.

Maintain content quality and hygiene

Run strong QA before publish, including metadata, links, learner flow, structure, and accuracy checks.

Keep Academy content current through refreshes, version control, update logs, and proactive identification of stale or conflicting material.

Maintain clear documentation of what changed, why it changed, and what needs follow-up.

Iterate based on feedback and signals

Track learner feedback and basic performance signals to identify where Academy content or structure can improve.

Ship small, evidence-led improvements and document what changed and why.

Escalate bigger structural or learning-approach recommendations when needed, backed by evidence and clear rationale.

Partner across teams

Work closely with Product, Customer Success, Support, Revenue Enablement, SMEs, and other cross-functional partners to keep content aligned with the product and with real user needs.

Communicate changes clearly: what changed, why it matters, and what someone should do next.

Support smoother launches and rollouts by making sure content, guidance, and enablement stay connected.

Use AI and product fluency as a force multiplier

Become a true Synthesia power user who can build, test, demo, and explain core workflows with confidence.

Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate drafting, structuring, and iteration while maintaining a high quality bar and verifying outputs carefully.

Bring curiosity, speed, and good judgment to how you work.

Who You Are

You’re a strong content builder who cares deeply about clarity, learner experience, and craft.

You’re comfortable owning Academy content from developing to publish and you like making things that help people get unstuck. You’re comfortable owning details, working across multiple systems, and improving content through iteration rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’re organized, resourceful, and collaborative. You communicate clearly, ask good questions, and care about whether the work actually lands with the people it’s meant to help. You’re equally comfortable drafting a guide, publishing a module, tightening a workflow, spotting a broken learner path, or improving a previous release.

What We’re Looking For

Must-haves


 * Experience creating customer-facing learning, enablement, or product education content
 * Experience publishing and maintaining content in an LMS or Academy environment
 * Strong writing and information design skills, with the ability to simplify complex workflows clearly
 * Strong QA habits and attention to detail across links, metadata, structure, and learner flow
 * Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Support, Customer Success, and SMEs
 * A data-informed approach to iteration, using feedback and simple signals to improve what you ship
 * Strong product curiosity and the ability to become a credible Synthesia power user.
   
   

Nice-to-haves


 * Experience in B2B SaaS, customer education, or scaled self-serve enablement
 * Experience working across Academy, help center, and in-app education surfaces
 * Familiarity with taxonomy, content audits, or information architecture
 * Experience using Synthesia or other AI-powered content creation tools
 * Experience supporting webinars, live sessions, or virtual facilitation
 * Additional proficient language skills are a plus in French/German/Spanish
   
   

Why Join Synthesia

Help customers go beyond quick answers

The Academy is where customers build deeper understanding and lasting capability. You’ll play a key role in making that journey clear, connected, and genuinely useful.

Build with craft, autonomy, and influence

You won’t just publish content. You’ll improve structure, raise quality, spot friction early, and help shape how the Academy evolves as Synthesia and our customers grow.

Raise the bar on quality

This is a role for someone who cares about clarity, structure, and detail. You’ll have the trust to improve what exists, identify what’s missing, and help the Academy become a more effective part of the customer journey over time.

Join a team building for the future of work

Synthesia is redefining how businesses communicate and learn with AI. You’ll be part of a fast-moving, high-trust environment where enablement is treated as a real product experience, not an afterthought.

title: Head of Customer Success Management (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Customer Success ist bei OneCareer kein Support-Ticket, sie ist ein zentraler Wachstumshebel sowohl für Teilnehmende als auch für uns. Als Head of Customer Success gestaltest du eine CS-Organisation, die nicht reagiert, sondern vorausdenkt: Du baust Strukturen, die skalieren, führst ein Team, das sich gegenseitig zur Bestleistung pusht, und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Teilnehmenden nicht nur abschließen – sondern ankommen. Wenn dich das antreibt, freuen wir uns auf dich.

Strategie & Skalierung


 * Du entwickelst die gesamte Customer-Success-Funktion strategisch weiter – von Prozessen über Playbooks bis zur Teamstruktur
 * Du entkoppelst Betreuungsqualität von Teamgröße: durch KI-gestützte Workflows, Automatisierungen und Self-Service-Formate
 * Du baust ein Performance-Dashboard auf, das Zufriedenheits-, Nutzungs- und Vermittlungsdaten in echte Steuerungsentscheidungen verwandelt
   
   

Führung & Teamentwicklung


 * Du führst das CS-Team disziplinarisch und fachlich – mit dem Anspruch, Menschen weiterzubringen, nicht nur Aufgaben zu verteilen
 * Du schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Feedback direkt ist, Erwartungen klar sind und Leistung sichtbar wird
   
   

Onboarding & Teilnehmendenerfahrung


 * Du baust skalierbare Onboarding-Prozesse auf, die Teilnehmende vom ersten Tag an abholen und durch die gesamte Lernreise begleiten
 * Du verantwortest zentrale KPIs: NPS, Onboarding Completion Rate, Kursabschlussquoten, First Response Time, Resolution Time
   
   

Schnittstellenmanagement & Qualität


 * Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Operations zusammen – als strategische Stimme der Kundenperspektive
 * Du pflegst relevante Stakeholder-Beziehungen, u. a. zu Jobcentern, und stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards sicher
   
   

Dein Profil


 * Mindestens 5 Jahre disziplinarische Führungserfahrung in einer CS-, Account- oder kundennahen Funktion – idealerweise hast du dabei auch Team Leads geführt
 * Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Skalierung von Customer-Success-Strukturen: Prozesse, Playbooks, Automatisierungen
 * Fundiertes KPI-Verständnis: NPS, Churn, CSAT, SLA-Compliance und Onboarding-Metriken sind für dich kein Neuland
 * Du denkst in Systemen, nicht in Einzelfällen – und baust lieber Strukturen, die Probleme verhindern, als sie zu lösen
 * Sicherer Umgang mit CS-Plattformen wie HubSpot, Intercom oder Zendesk sowie KI-gestützten Workflow-Tools
 * Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
 * Erfahrung im EdTech-, SaaS- oder B2C-Umfeld mit hoher Interaktionsdichte von Vorteil
 * Kenntnisse im geförderten Bildungsmarkt (BGS, AZAV) sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
   
   

Warum wir?

Wir machen keine Kurse – wir machen Karrieren. Das gilt für unsere Kunden genauso wie für uns selbst: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, fordern uns gegenseitig und helfen einander, besser zu werden. Bei uns findest du keine Politik, keine Ellbogen – dafür Menschen, die Klartext reden und füreinander einstehen.


 * Maximale Freiheit mit Wurzeln: Das Beste aus zwei Welten vereint. Wir sind eine Remote-first Company, legen jedoch Wert darauf - abhängig von der Position - sich bis zu 3 Mal im Monat zu begegnen
 * Professionelles Onboarding: Auch wenn wir uns nicht jeden Tag sehen, bist du vom ersten Tag an voll integriert
 * Reise-Support: Wir organisieren und übernehmen die Kosten für unsere regelmäßigen Strategie- und Team-Events
 * Hochwertige Apple-Ausstattung und moderne Tools
 * Monatliches Benefitbudget von 100 €: Flexibel einsetzbar für Urban Sports Club, Internetpauschale, Essenszuschüsse, diverse Gutscheine und vieles mehr
 * 60 Tage Workation (mit den üblichen Einschränkungen aufgrund von Datenschutz, Sozial- und Steuerrecht)
 * Wir haben 31 bezahlte Urlaubstage. Und wenn du mal eine längere Auszeit brauchst? Dann stocken wir flexibel auf bis zu 50 Tage auf
   
   

Über uns

Wir sind ein Bildungsträger für staatlich geförderte Online-Weiterbildungen - vor allem aber sind wir ein richtig gutes Team.

Was du in der Arbeit tust, ist immer auch ein großer Teil davon, was du mit deinem Leben tust, denn Arbeitszeit ist Lebenszeit.

Bei der OneCareer GmbH erlebst du jeden Tag, wie unglaublich es ist, wenn ein Team für ein gemeinsames Ziel brennt. Wir sind mehr als nur Kollegen – wir sind eine Einheit, die an das Gleiche glaubt und alles gibt. Das ist nicht nur ein Job, das ist eine Mission. Wer das nachempfinden kann, ist hier richtig. Hier entsteht etwas Großes, und das soll erst mal einer nachmachen!

Wenn du gleich tickst, freuen wir uns, dich bald bei uns wilkommen zu heißen!

Bergfreunde wurde 2006 gegründet mit der Mission, Menschen mit der Leidenschaft für Draußen zu verbinden und zu inspirieren. Heute sind wir einer der größten Outdoor-Online-Händler Europas mit mehr als 700 Mitarbeiter:innen. Unsere Werte bilden unseren Kompass: Mit Leidenschaft dabei. Große Ziele wagen. Gemeinsam unterwegs. Respektvoll. Wir packens an. Unser Potenzial und unsere Ambitionen sind groß: Wir wollen unser Wachstum fortsetzen - bist Du dabei?

Das erwartet Dich


 * Du entwickelst eine klare Produktvision für unsere Merchandising- und Planungssysteme und leitest daraus eine outcome-orientierte Produktstrategie ab.
 * Du verantwortest den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus - von Discovery über Delivery bis zum Lernen - mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Wirkung statt kurzfristiger Optimierungen.
 * Du identifizierst relevante Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und validierst Lösungen datenbasiert, z. B. durch Analysen, Interviews und Experimente (A/B-Tests).
 * Du übersetzt Produktentscheidungen in messbare Ergebnisse, etwa bessere Forecasts, höheren Bestandsumschlag oder schnellere Entscheidungen.
 * Du arbeitest eng und auf Augenhöhe mit den Engineering- und Data-Teams zusammen und ihr tragt gemeinsam Verantwortung für Produktentscheidungen.
 * Du steuerst Erwartungen und Prioritäten im Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, insbesondere mit dem Merchandising, und schaffst Klarheit über Ziele und Fokus.
 * Du entwickelst produktorientierte Arbeitsweisen, Routinen und Outcome-KPIs kontinuierlich weiter und stärkst agile Prinzipien sowie bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und Lernkultur.
   
   

Das bringst Du mit


 * Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL, Supply Chain Management oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
 * Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Manager:in für digitale Produkte, idealerweise im E-Commerce-, Handels- oder datengetriebenen Umfeld.
 * Erfahrung mit hypothesengetriebener Produktentwicklung sowie der Arbeit mit messbaren Zielen (KPIs/OKRs).
 * Ein starkes analytisches Verständnis und Freude an datenbasierten Entscheidungen.
 * Eine klare, strukturierte Kommunikation sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
 * Eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Spaß an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit.
   
   

Deshalb solltest Du bei uns anfangen

Bei Uns Bist Du Teil Eines Motivierten Teams, Das Sich Über Die Verschiedenen Abteilungen Hinweg Gegenseitig Unterstützt Und Austauscht. Das Erwartet Dich Außerdem Bei Uns:


 * Flexibles Arbeiten: flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten, Workation (EWR + Schweiz), 30 Urlaubstage
 * Mobilität: Jobticket, unmittelbare Nähe zum Bahnhof, Jobrad, Fahrradschuppen & Duschen
 * Events: After-Work, Wandertage, Teamevents, gemeinsame Bergfreundefeiern
 * Gesundheit: Yoga-Klassen, Fitnessraum, Gesundheits- und Nachhaltigkeitswochen, Sportgruppen
 * Entwicklung: Stärkenorientierung, offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten, Sprachkurse, Ausbilderschein, Fachkonferenzen
 * Goodies: Shoprabatt, Verkauf von B-Ware, betriebliche Altersvorsorge

title: Head of Partnerships - Integrations & Applications
description:
About Trackunit

Trackunit is a fast-growing, leading provider of IoT and telematics solutions for the global construction industry, operating out of offices worldwide. At the heart of our platform is IrisX — a purpose-built data and AI platform that connects machines, people, and systems to drive real-time, actionable insights across the construction ecosystem.

IrisX is more than a product. It is the foundation on which OEMs, enterprise software providers, ConTech innovators, and AI platforms build, connect, and create value. As we scale IrisX into a true ecosystem platform, Integrations & Applications sits at the engine of that growth.

Role Overview

Trackunit is looking for a Head of Partnerships - Integrations & Applications to lead the primary engine of IrisX credit consumption and ecosystem scale. This is a senior, cross-functional leadership role within the Partnerships function, reporting to the VP of Platform.

You will own all third-party integrations across ERP, ConTech, and AI platforms, turning enterprise software and ecosystem partnerships into live, recurring IrisX consumption. You will lead a cross-functional pod — including a dedicated Product Manager, Platform Engineer, Field Marketing Manager, and Regional Managers — and operate as the structural engine that converts partner demand into built, shipped, and adopted integrations.

This role is pivotal in Trackunit’s IrisX Acceleration strategy. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, GTM, and Marketing to ensure Trackunit becomes the platform that enterprise partners build on — not just connect to.

What You’ll Own

Integrations & Applications Leadership


 * Own the full lifecycle of third-party integrations: sourcing, scoping, building, launching, and scaling across ERP (e.g. SAP, Oracle), fleet management systems, ConTech platforms, and AI application layers
 * Drive IrisX credit consumption as the primary commercial metric for your team’s success
 * Define and maintain a prioritised integration roadmap, balancing partner demand, P&E capacity, and IrisX platform readiness
 * Ensure integrations compound into reusable marketplace connectors, building long-term platform stickiness
   
   

Cross-Functional Pod Leadership


 * Lead and develop a cross-functional Integrations & Applications pod, including a dedicated Partnerships Product Manager, Platform Engineer, Field Marketing Manager, and Regional Partnership Managers as the function scales globally
 * Operate a disciplined weekly cadence across the pod, with structured interlocks into P&E and GTM leadership
 * Work closely with Platform Engineering to ensure IrisX is built for partners to extend, not just consume — including AI agent compatibility and self-serve developer onboarding
 * Collaborate with the Platform Partnerships Lead (embedded in Product) to formally prioritise integration demand within the P&E roadmap
   
   

Partner Pipeline & GTM


 * Build and manage a structured integration partner pipeline, with clear qualification criteria, engagement stages, and commercial terms
 * Lead co-sell and co-marketing motions globally with Field Marketing, with a clear path to building out and leading Regional Partnership Managers as the function grows
 * Drive partner onboarding through the IrisX marketplace and developer portal, with a focus on low-touch, scalable activation
 * Work alongside the Head of Partnerships and GTM leadership to align partner-sourced pipeline with direct sales motions
   
   

Platform & Marketplace


 * Actively contribute to the IrisX Marketplace strategy — ensuring integrations are discoverable, adoptable, and commercially visible to customers and partners
 * Partner with Developer Experience Engineering to improve sandbox environments, API documentation, and self-serve onboarding for ISVs and enterprise software partners
 * Represent partner integration demand in internal P&E discussions, ensuring Trackunit’s platform evolves in line with ecosystem needs
   
   

Qualifications


 * 10+ years of experience in partnerships, platform integrations, business development, or product roles within enterprise software, SaaS, or IoT environments
 * Demonstrated track record of building and scaling integration partnership programs — from pipeline and scoping through to live, revenue-generating deployments
 * Strong cross-functional leadership experience: able to lead without direct authority across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams
 * Commercial acumen: understands how integrations translate into platform consumption, ARR, and ecosystem defensibility
 * Experience working with ERP, fleet management, ConTech, or related enterprise software ecosystems is a strong advantage
 * Excellent communication and executive presence — able to engage confidently with C-suite partners and internal senior stakeholders
 * Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with a strong bias for action and structured thinking
 * Experience with marketplace platforms, developer portals, or partner-facing product surfaces is highly valued
 * Comfortable working remotely and operating across global time zones; this is a globally-scoped role with the opportunity to build and lead a regional org over time
   
   

Why This Role

IrisX is positioned to become the platform layer of the global construction industry. This role is one of the most strategically important hires in the IrisX Acceleration plan — the person who turns ecosystem ambition into shipped integrations, live consumption, and a partner network that compounds over time.

You will operate with real ownership, a cross-functional team, and executive visibility — and you will have the opportunity to shape how the construction industry’s leading IoT platform opens up to the wider ecosystem.

Our Hiring Process

Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.


 * Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other a bit better.
 * Virtual meet and greet. Meet with XXX
 * Personality-based interview. You will be asked to fill out an online personality assessment using use Hogan prior to the interview. Our Hogan assessment enables us to understand your abilities and how you align with our team culture. Instead of seeking 'appropriate' responses, the priority is to develop a meaningful exchange that illustrates your synergy with the Trackunit team.
 * Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.
 * If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.
 * Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!
   
   

Coming Together To Connect Construction

We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider, but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

title: Product Manager Biotech & Pharma
description:
Team Player wanted

Industrial Flow is a new division within the Atlas Copco Group, and part of the Power Technique Business Area.

We master industrial flow solutions for demanding applications with leading technology in positive displacement and centrifugal pumps, valves, and systems. Among our leading brands are LEWA, Varisco or Wangen. They have a strong presence in various industries, including Food and Beverage, Healthcare, Biogas, Wastewater, and the Process Industry, with a vast growth potential. With a worldwide presence, we know our customers and their applications, adding value with our expertise and supporting their de-carbonization journeys.

Your role

As Product Manager, you will play a key role in shaping and growing our pump portfolio for biotech and pharma manufacturing applications within LEWA GmbH and the Industrial Flow Division. You will drive innovation, align market needs with technical excellence, and contribute to our strategic growth.

As a Prodct Manager you will


 * Define and execute product-market strategies based on global market trends, customer needs, and regulatory developments.
 * Own the product lifecycle from concept to commercialization, including business case development and technical specifications.
 * Drive cross-functional collaboration with Sales, R&D, Supply Chain, and Finance to deliver on roadmap priorities.
 * Ensure strong market positioning by aligning product features with sector-specific requirements and customer expectations.
 * Support go-to-market activities through training, campaign input, and close cooperation with Communications and Sales.
 * Present and communicate product initiatives effectively to senior management and key stakeholders.
   
   

To succeed, you will need

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role


 * In-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including fluid handling processes, single-use technologies, and downstream processing steps such as filtration and chromatography, along with relevant regulatory frameworks.
 * Proven experience in product management, technical sales, or project management within industrial or life science environments.
 * Strong commercial and technical acumen, supported by a university degree and a track record of strategic thinking.
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, enabling stakeholder alignment across functions and regions.
 * Fluency in English, with German preferred; additional languages are a plus.
 * A proactive, analytical mindset, with curiosity, flexibility, and a drive for continuous improvement.
   
   

In return, we offer


 * Culture of trust and accountability
 * Lifelong learning and career growth
 * Innovation powered by people
 * Comprehensive compensation and benefits
 * Health and well-being
   
   

Job location

Hybrid

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Site in Leonberg, Germany.

Contact information

Talent Acquisition Team: Heike Geissinger

Part of Atlas Copco Group

At Atlas Copco, we believe that passionate people create extraordinary things. We promote lifelong learning and want our employees to grow, develop new skills and competencies, and gain new experiences.
